env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 0.3: eject emits valid Go. A platform store that ends in a line
# comment still ejects to a program that builds with go1.27.2 and prints
# what the logos run prints.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^have have have$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/platcomment

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
)

func pick() *flag.Flag {
	return flag.Lookup("have") // comment after a return value
}

func main() {
	flag.String("have", "HAVE", "")
	var a *flag.Flag = flag.Lookup("have") // comment after a declaration
	var b *flag.Flag = flag.Lookup("have")
	b = flag.Lookup("have") // comment after an assignment
	fmt.Println(a.Name, b.Name, pick().Name)
}
